_about: Public-domain C. I. Scofield (Cyrus Ingerson Scofield, 1843-1921) for the Word Hoard, his own books and not the Scofield Reference Bible: Plain Papers on the Doctrine of the Holy Spirit (copyright 1899), the Scofield Bible Correspondence School Course of Study vols. 1-3 (ninth edition, copyright 1907), Addresses on Prophecy (catalogued 1914), The New Life in Christ Jesus (1915), What Do the Prophets Say? (1918), In Many Pulpits (1922), Rightly Dividing the Word of Truth (2nd ed., 1923), and three compilations of his writings by other hands (Reid 1913, Pohle 1918, Gaebelein 1920), raw Internet Archive OCR. Dispensationalist; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
